name.title: Alias name
name.description: The alias which will get expanded to a command

command.title: Alias command
command.description: The command will is run when the alias is used. The command can reference positional arguments using $1, $2 etc.

description.title: Alias description
description.description: Description about what the alias does. The text will be included in the tab completion

shell.title: Shell option
shell.description: Set to true if the alias should be executed in a shell

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Executable provided by the extension. Arguments under the mount path which do not match another command are passed to the binary

path.title: Binary path
path.description: Path to the binary relative to the extension folder. On Windows, .exe is added if the path has no file extension. Defaults to bin/<extension-name>

mount.title: Mount path
mount.description: Space separated command path under the extension name where the binary is mounted. Defaults to the extension root

completion.title: Completion
completion.description: Forward tab completion to the binary. Use cobra for binaries built with github.com/spf13/cobra

command.title: Binary command
command.description: Command provided by the extension's binary. Requires the binary property

name.title: Command path
name.description: Space separated command path under the extension name. Spaces create nested command groups

exec.title: Binary arguments
exec.description: Arguments passed to the binary before the user's arguments. Defaults to the command name split on spaces

output.title: Output
output.description: Use json if the command writes JSON to stdout, so c8y can format it (views, --select, --output). Use raw to pass the output through unchanged

version.title: Extension version
version.description: Extension version. Reserved for future use

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Custom aliases which are included in the extension

commands.title: Binary commands
commands.description: Commands provided by the extension's binary
